rationale: At 03:00 ET the European cash markets open and the first 5-minute candle shows which side the early European buyers or sellers took, so when its body fills most of its range that side keeps winning through the thin morning before the 08:30 release, and a small body is indecision that chops; the main setting is the share of the candle's range that is body. Losing side: Traders who fade the first European candle and are stopped as the morning drifts its way.
notes: open_candle: the tf candle that opens at 08:30 ET (the data release; start 0200 / 0300 = the London opens, 1800 / 2000 = the evening candles of the Globex day before the trade date) is followed at its close in its own direction (green long, red short); optional size gates, all off at 0: range >= k x ATR, body >= body_r of its range, volume >= vol_m x the median of the same bar over 14 dates, body >= body_pts points; one trade a session, flat 15:58
